title: Sea Otters: Tiny Guardians of the Kelp Forest

questions.sentence: _____ they're such social animals, they often hang out together.
Mama sea otters have to keep a very close eye on their pups, _____ they don't float away.

questions.question: Which word introduces a contrast?
questions.explain: But shows a difference or contrast.

questions.sentence: _____ urchins love kelp so much, they can wipe out entire underwater forests.

questions.question: In 'But, otters aren't the only ones at the buffet', which word shows contrast?
questions.explain: But contrasts with the previous idea.

questions.sentence: Why do sea otters float in seaweed? _____ the kelp keeps them safe.

questions.question: Which is the correct sentence?
options: Why do sea otters float in seaweed? Because the kelp keeps them safe.
Why do sea otters float in seaweed? So the kelp keeps them safe.
Why do sea otters float in seaweed? But the kelp keeps them safe.
Why do sea otters float in seaweed? Although the kelp keeps them safe.

questions.sentence: They float in kelp forests _____ they don't drift too far out to sea.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Because they are social animals, they hang out together.
Because they are social animals, so they hang out together.
They hang out together because they are social animals, but they don't.
Because they are social animals, they hang out together, so they are.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Mama otters watch their pups so they don't float away.
Mama otters watch their pups because they don't float away.
Mama otters watch their pups but they don't float away.
Mama otters watch their pups although they don't float away.

questions.correct: Because they're such social animals, they often hang out together.

questions.sentence: So, why do sea otters float in seaweed? _____ the kelp keeps them safe and they help do the same in return.
